## Personality

Lilly is a person who appears to derive a gruesome pleasure from recounting her various physical ailments. She frequently details her many aches, pains, and sicknesses to others.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Jonas P3](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0003)_

## History

Lilly was an eccentric boarder staying at Cousin Emily's boarding house over the summer. Her unusual personality was among the defining features of the house's colorful household during Philippa's stay.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Jonas P1](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0001), [v3 ch.Jonas P2](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0002), [v3 ch.Jonas P18](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0018), [v3 ch.Jonas P19](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0019), [v3 ch.Jonas P23](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0023)_
